name: Monsoon Wooding
line: About 5,000 trees a year in Delhi NCR. Over 50,000 planted and survived.
deck: The verb is ours and it is the whole campaign: planted and survived.

aims.p: The claim is a survivor count and it costs a second visit to make. A planting number can be produced on the day, and we have decided that is not the claim.

aims.h: Work with the weather rather than around it
aims.p: The campaign is aimed at the few weeks a year when a sapling in this city has odds at all. Everything else is scheduling.
What this is trying to get a tree through is the second summer. Almost everything that kills a sapling in Delhi happens once everybody has gone home.

how.p: The plantings are all over Delhi rather than gathered in one showpiece site.
We go back and count how many are still standing against how many went in. Most tree numbers you read are the day of the photograph. This one is the year after.

activities.name: Plant
activities.p: Through the monsoon months in Delhi, because that is when a sapling lives. The season is not a theme — it is the reason a survival figure is worth counting at all. The planting is done by volunteers, so the size of the campaign in any year is a straight count of who turned up in the rain.

frame.alt: Children in sun hats and red jackets at a planting site

activities.name: Protect
activities.p: A sapling in Delhi has a fence, a summer and a road crew to survive. Planting day is the photograph; the two years after it are the campaign.

frame.alt: Young plants at knee height in a nursery bed

activities.cap: Young plants at our own nursery, not at a planting site.

activities.name: Promote
activities.p: The least measurable of the three. Getting somebody who planted once to come back the following monsoon is what turns a season into a campaign.

who.p: The planting is done by whoever turns up in the rain, which is why the size of a season and the number of people in it are the same figure.

who.h: The neighbourhoods that get the trees
who.p: Plantings are spread across Delhi rather than gathered in one place. Fifty thousand survivors, somewhere behind you.
They are the population this campaign counts. Everything else is about keeping them alive.

done.h: Over fifty thousand, planted and survived
done.p: About five thousand trees a year across Delhi NCR, and over fifty thousand still alive. The second number is the one that took work.
IndusInd Bank, PwC, Amazon, Adobe, S&P Global.

holes.what: We count survivors against what was planted, so a rate exists — but we cannot publish one here, because the planted total behind the fifty thousand is not written down anywhere we can cite.
holes.unlocks: One number: how many went into the ground. With it, this page can state a survival rate instead of describing a method.

holes.what: How long after planting the count is taken is not recorded, and it is the difference between a sapling that made it and one that had not died yet.
holes.unlocks: The interval. A year, two years, whatever it actually is.

holes.what: The sites are spread across Delhi and we hold no geo locations for them, so there is nowhere on this page a reader can go and stand.
holes.unlocks: Coordinates, or even a list of neighbourhoods, for the seasons we can still reconstruct.

statement.under: The verb we use is survived. It is the only part of a tree number that takes any work.
